test_restart_handler_writes_dedup_marker: test the /restart handler writes a dedup marker JSON file with the triggering update_id and platform
test_redelivered_restart_with_same_updat: test that a /restart with the same update_id as a recorded marker is silently ignored as a redelivery
test_redelivered_restart_with_older_upda: test that a /restart with an older update_id than the recorded marker is treated as stale and ignored
test_fresh_restart_with_higher_update_id: test that a new /restart with a higher update_id bypasses the dedup guard and proceeds normally
test_stale_marker_older_than_5min_does_n: test that a dedup marker older than 5 minutes is ignored so a fresh /restart proceeds
